phase.name: Pricing & Taxation Management
phase.objective: Establish one authoritative pricing, tax and discount engine that Sales and Purchase consume rather than duplicating commercial calculation rules inside their own domains.

critical_business_rules: Pricing is the authoritative owner of price, tax and discount rules.
Sales and Purchase must consume Pricing instead of duplicating pricing logic.
Pricing must not own Sales Invoice, Purchase Invoice, Stock or Ledger transactions.
Tax calculation must be authoritative and deterministic.
Discount evaluation must be authoritative and deterministic.
Rule priority and conflicts must be explicitly defined.
Tax-inclusive versus tax-exclusive semantics must be finalized explicitly.
Transaction-time commercial values must be persisted/snapshotted correctly.
Manual discount overrides require explicit authorization.
Backend calculation is authoritative; UI calculations are for user experience.
Offline pricing mutations must use Outbox and idempotent synchronization.

principles: UI permission checks are only an additional UX layer.
Pricing master mutations must be auditable.
Manual price/discount overrides must be permission controlled.

ui_standards: Pricing workflows should support keyboard-first navigation.
Price-list grids should support search, filtering, sorting and efficient entry.
Tax and discount forms should provide immediate validation feedback.
Calculation preview should clearly separate base price, discount, taxable amount, tax and final amount.
Manual discount overrides should clearly show permission requirements.
UI must not expose actions the current user cannot perform.

purchase: Resolve purchase cost/pricing context where applicable
Apply tax and discount rules where applicable
inventory: Pricing can consume Batch context where required.
Pricing does not own Batch or Stock.
financial: Financial remains responsible for accounting entries and monetary posting.

offline_sync.rule: Pricing changes must not be silently overwritten during synchronization.

source_boundary.reason: The supplied database overview explicitly identifies the four Pricing tables but does not provide complete field-level definitions in the retrieved source. The backlog therefore intentionally includes schema/business-rule finalization work rather than inventing unsupported columns or relationships.

definition_of_done: All four approved Pricing tables are implemented according to finalized schema decisions.
Price resolution has one authoritative implementation.
Tax calculation has one authoritative implementation.
Discount evaluation has one authoritative implementation.
Sales and Purchase do not duplicate pricing rules.
Transaction-time commercial values are persisted correctly.
Pricing changes work offline.
Outbox synchronization is reliable and idempotent.
Conflict behavior is documented and tested.
Permissions are enforced in backend services.
Audit history is complete for pricing mutations and overrides.
Angular workflows are keyboard-first.
Unit tests pass.
API tests pass.
E2E tests pass.
Synchronization tests pass.
SQLite compatibility is verified.
PostgreSQL compatibility is verified.
Performance targets are measured and documented.
Phase documentation is complete.
